_comment: Scripted reference traces, one per scenario in agent_scenarios.json: the calls a good agent makes on the synthetic baseline mailbox, each call's structuredContent trimmed to the fields the scorers read, and the IDs the answer cites, with abstained: true where the answer says the mailbox holds no answer. A counting trace's answer also records count, the number of messages it reports, as a JSON integer. An outstanding-items trace's answer records items (action, owner, status, due, cited), excluded (action, status, cited), complete and limitations; its calls were generated from the real tools on the built baseline index and trimmed, get_thread bodies to the empty string (null stays null) beside body_omitted_chars, which is all the scorer reads of them. tests/test_agent_eval.py requires each to score with no failures. Claimant-ID hash suffixes are placeholders, not the real file hashes.
